title: Shelf Life Digital Reading Journal for Goodnotes, 100 Linked Book Review Pages, Book Tracker, Reading Log and TBR, iPad and Android, Undated
description:
Shelf Life is an undated digital reading journal for readers who want one place on their tablet for every book they finish. Write a title in the Library, tap its number, and that book's own review page opens. Start in any month, the day you buy it.

What's inside: 126 portrait pages in one PDF
- Cover and a Contents page that shows every section on one screen
- Start here: 4 numbered steps, each with a Go there button
- Setup check: tap the buttons to test the links on your own device, with a fix list if one does not jump
- Library: 4 pages with 25 numbered lines each (title, author, finished, stars and a blank Shelf column you name yourself)
- 100 book review pages, one per book, numbered 1 to 100, each linked from its Library line
- To be read list: 26 lines for title, author, where you heard about it and a Got it box
- 2 favorite quotes pages
- Reading year: your goal, a row of 10 squares for each month (tally past 10), tallies and your top 5 of the year
- 12 undated monthly reading pages, each with 8 lines for books finished (more go in that month's Notes)
- 2 notes pages

Good to know: a digital PDF for note apps. Portrait only and undated. No stickers. It is not a fillable form: write with your pen or type with your app's text tool.

What makes it different
- 100 books, all linked both ways. Tap a number in the Library to open that book's page. Tap Library at the top of the book page to go back to the right Library page, or use the arrows to step to the previous or next book.
- One page layout to learn. Every book page is the same: title and author, genre, format (tick print, ebook or audio, or write another in the blank), started and finished dates, pages, stars, would I reread, why I picked it up, my thoughts, a favorite quote with its page number, a favorite character and a one-line review.
- Working in five minutes. The cover's Open journal button takes you to Start here, and the Setup check page shows the links work on your device before you write anything.
- See your reading year. Set a goal, color one square per finished book in each month's row and tap any month name to open its page.
- Monthly pages to look back and plan ahead: books finished with stars, 31 reading days to color in, pages or hours read, book of the month and what is up next.
- Easy to get around. Month tabs on every page, a top bar for Home, Library, TBR and Quotes, and a trail that works as a back button.
- Yours to set up. The Shelf column and genre are written in by you, and format has a blank for anything that is not print, ebook or audio, so it fits any kind of reader.
- A quiet library look: warm ivory paper, deep ink blue text and one oxblood accent, with text that stays crisp at any zoom.
- Help inside the file. The instructions are printed on the pages, not only in a separate guide.

Works with
- Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf
- on iPad, Android tablets and Windows tablets
You need a PDF note app like one of these to tap the links and write on the pages.

Not for
- Phones: the pages are tablet size
- Files, Photos and other file viewers: they show the pages but do not follow the links
- Anyone who wants a spreadsheet or a fillable form: this is a PDF you write on by hand or with your app's text tool

Links not tapping? Turn the pen off to follow a link and back on to write.

How to start
1. Download the file from Etsy in a web browser. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
2. Open the PDF in your note app and import it as a PDF.
3. Tap the Setup check buttons, then open the Library, write your first title on line 1 and tap its number.

Questions buyers ask
- The Etsy app won't download it. Use a web browser (Safari, Chrome) and go to Purchases. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
- Which app do I need? A PDF note app: Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo or Noteshelf.
- The links don't tap. Turn the pen off (read or view mode). The Setup check page tests this in seconds.
- Can I type in it? Yes, with your app's text tool and any font your app has. It isn't a fillable form, so there are no typing boxes.
- Can I turn it to landscape? No. It is portrait only, like a book held upright, and every page is laid out for that.

What you get
- Shelf-Life.pdf (2.88 MB, 126 pages, portrait)
One PDF, not a zip, so it downloads and imports quickly.
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
The Setup check page has a fix list. Still stuck? Send a message through Etsy and name your app and device.
